basic_details.job_title: UoH Senior Research Fellow/Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Senior Research Fellow (SRF)/Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is open in a CSIR-sponsored research project, "Economically-viable Rare-Earth-Free Permanent Magnets based on Binary and Pseudo-binary Intermetallic Alloys of Fe", at the School of Physics, University of Hyderabad. The fellowship is Rs.42,000/- p.m. for SRF and Rs.37,000/- p.m. for JRF, plus HRA (as per applicable rate), initially for 12 months. Applications go by email to [email protected], and filled-in applications must be received by 24 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The application form asks for age as on the last date of the notification. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for the following candidates. The notice points to https://csirhrdg.res.in/Home/Index/1/Default/3283/63 for the relaxation rules. | Category Relaxation Scheduled Castes/Tribes/OBC Up to 5 years Women Up to 5 years Physically handicapped Up to 5 years | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form "Form – B, Application for Position in the Project" attached to the notice. It asks for the post applied for, personal details, address, present position, educational qualifications, experience and two referees.
Paste a recent photograph on the form and sign the declaration.
Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates supporting the information given in the application, and note each proof number in the form.
Send the filled-in application by email to [email protected].
Make sure the application reaches by 24 November 2026, the last date for receipt of filled-in applications.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely temporary, and the appointee has no right to claim any regular appointment in the University. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test / skill test or at the time of joining. Only eligible candidates will be informed by email / letter at a later date. Entries in the application are declared to be true; if anything is found false at any stage, the candidature may be cancelled without assigning any reason.

rows.details: Economically-viable Rare-Earth-Free Permanent Magnets based on Binary and Pseudo-binary Intermetallic Alloys of Fe
Initially for 12 months, extended up till completion of the project based on performance and fund availability
SRF: Rs.42,000/- p.m. + HRA; JRF: Rs.37,000/- p.m. + HRA
School of Physics, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A single vacancy is advertised, to be filled either as Senior Research Fellow or as Junior Research Fellow. The notice states: "SRF candidate will be preferred if found suitable." SRF essential qualification (either of the two): M.Sc/BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree, and at least two years of post-MSc/BE/BTech research experience as evidenced from published papers in standard refereed journals, OR M.Tech/ME or equivalent degree in Engineering/Technology. Specialization in Condensed Matter Physics. Experience in synthesizing and characterizing structural and magnetic properties of intermetallic alloys. The application form asks for age as on the last date of the notification. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for the following candidates. The notice points to https://csirhrdg.res.in/Home/Index/1/Default/3283/63 for the relaxation rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: See the two options listed below the table
BS 4 years programme/Integrated BS-MS/MSc/BE/BTech or equivalent degree, with 55% marks and passing of valid NET/GATE score

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is paid over the fellowship at the applicable rate. The post is for a temporary period, purely on a contractual basis, in a time-bound research project. The appointment is initially for 12 months and can be extended up till the completion of the project, based on the candidate's performance and fund availability.

content_sections.heading: UoH Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: To carry out the experimental research work in the field of intermetallic alloys (synthesis, structural and magnetic characterisation).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form "Form – B, Application for Position in the Project" attached to the notice. It asks for the post applied for, personal details, address, present position, educational qualifications, experience and two referees. Paste a recent photograph on the form and sign the declaration. Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates supporting the information given in the application, and note each proof number in the form. Send the filled-in application by email to [email protected] . Make sure the application reaches by 24 November 2026 , the last date for receipt of filled-in applications.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in UoH Recruitment 2026 for SRF/JRF?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for Senior Research Fellow (SRF)/Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in the School of Physics project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UoH SRF/JRF post?
faq.answer: Filled-in applications must be received by 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for JRF?
faq.answer: A BS 4 years programme/Integrated BS-MS/MSc/BE/BTech or equivalent degree with 55% marks and a valid NET/GATE score.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for SRF?
faq.answer: M.Sc/BE/B.Tech or equivalent with at least two years of post-MSc/BE/BTech research experience shown by published papers in standard refereed journals, or an M.Tech/ME or equivalent degree in Engineering/Technology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 32 years for SRF and 28 years for JRF, with relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: SRF gets Rs.42,000/- p.m. and JRF gets Rs.37,000/- p.m., each plus HRA as per the applicable rate.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is paid in addition to the fellowship, as per the applicable rate.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for UoH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in Form – B, enclose self-attested copies of all certificates, and email the application to [email protected] by 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is temporary and purely contractual, initially for 12 months, with no right to claim a regular appointment in the University.

faq.question: Q10. Is SRF or JRF preferred?
faq.answer: The notice says an SRF candidate will be preferred if found suitable.
